title: Stage 13 — the assistant organises sheets, reads takeoff evidence and price books, and captures a verified backup
platform: Development browser (Vite dev server 127.0.0.1:8091 with the user-authorized Gemini key) · desktop 1280x800 · isolated agent-browser profile · Redburn BR250157 source imported · no build, installation or native run
summary: Second batch of assistant tools. The Live assistant can now read and organise the active source drawing's sheet register (rename with discipline, archive, recover — through the same saved sidecar the Sheets pane uses, with the retained evidence counted in every receipt), read calibration, traces, items and readiness blockers per sheet, read the project's price-book library without listing rates, and capture a verified workspace backup exactly as the Backups panel does. Mutations stay behind the per-message edit permission. With the real provider, one plain request performed all of it in eight tool calls; the existing eight-step pause then asked for a continue message, which produced the summary. The Sheets pane updated live and the backup appears in the Backups dialog.

requirements.change: read_source_sheets, manage_source_sheet, read_takeoff_evidence, read_price_books, capture_project_backup; 65/65 focused tests, typecheck exit 0; real-provider journey with inspected screenshots (proof/growth/2026-09-09-assistant-workbench/README.md).
requirements.remaining: Dans1 build, production and native runs; trace/calibration editing, price-book import, quotes, exports and backup restore remain unavailable by design; eight-step cap unchanged.
